answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Sponsor bonds: a newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with 45 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 12 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 45 POA on a stranger. Sponsors who never get slashed earn a premium other agents can see. The vine test is the live device, the ivory test is the locked stake, and the glacier test is the graded history no template can fake. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
